Series::ger¶

Back to Series API Reference

Signature¶

Series::ger(const Series& other) const -> Series

What It Does¶

ger() is an exact alias of outer() — the BLAS spelling of the vector outer product (ger = “general rank-1”). The receiver is [m], other is [n], the result is the [m, n] matrix with (i, j) entry a[i] * b[j].

See outer() for the full description, gradient rules, and examples.

Parameters¶

other (const Series&) — the [n] second vector.

Returns¶

Series The [m, n] outer-product matrix. Differentiable in both operands.

Example¶

auto a = pluss::make_series({1.0, 2.0});
auto b = pluss::make_series({3.0, 4.0, 5.0});

std::cout << a.ger(b);

Output¶

pluss::Series(shape=[2,3], strides=[3,1], dtype=float64, platform=cpu, numel=6, contiguous=true)
data=[[3, 4, 5],
  [6, 8, 10]]
